sections.heading: Caine's Megladeath
sections.wikitext:
Megladeath was used by [[Captain Caine]] in the ocean alongside his newly-recovered [[Triton]] Titan to fight two other Triton [[Titans]] summoned by the [[Huntik Foundation]] that they had recovered from the sunken lighthouse of Alexandria. {{Source|The Treasures of Alexandria}}

Caine later invoked Megladeath to on the mysterious Titan island where it defeated [[Dante Vale]]'s [[Caliban]]. He then fought [[Triton]] before being defeated by [[Montehue]] and the Huntik team. {{Source|The Headless Horseman}}

full_text:
Megladeath is a gargantuan Draco-Titan sea-monster that resembles a blue-bodied plesiosaur with a spiked red helmet. The undisputed lord of the sea, Megladeath is used by the Organization for aquatic combat.

History

Caine's Megladeath

Megladeath was used by Captain Caine in the ocean alongside his newly-recovered Triton Titan to fight two other Triton Titans summoned by the Huntik Foundation that they had recovered from the sunken lighthouse of Alexandria. [The Treasures of Alexandria]

Caine later invoked Megladeath to on the mysterious Titan island where it defeated Dante Vale's Caliban. He then fought Triton before being defeated by Montehue and the Huntik team. [The Headless Horseman]

Suit's Megladeath

Whilst searching for the Flying Dutchman, one of Diaz's Suits summoned a Megaladeath Titan alongside Redcap and Mindrone to attack the Huntik team in the sea. [The Secret of the Flying Dutchman]

Abilities

Sporting deadly sharped teeth and massive spiked fins, Megledeath is the ideal Titan for underwater combat, with few Titans being able to hold their own in the water with him. His tail possesses a spiked wrecking ball, allow him to cause massive damage to those he swipes.

Gallery

Image caption: Megladeath's Amulet

Image caption: Megladeath's Icon

Trivia

• Megladeath's appearance is based off the Loch Ness Monster and the Plesiosauria, extinct marine reptiles. His name is derived from the Megalodon, an extinct species of shark.
